description: Phase-CTX — Context Engineering Substrate. 5 stories (~+900 LOC, 3 sessions). Plan: .planning/post-drift-2026-05-21/Phase-CTX/plan.md. Builds the layered tool-output compression stack: ContextEngine ABC + ContextCompressor (hermes) + payload_summarizer trait (openhuman) + auto-compact at 70% threshold (Codex). Critical integration note 2026-05-23: TokenJuice (internal/tokenjuice, already live) is layer-1 deterministic rule compactor; US-CTX-03 payload_summarizer is layer-2 LLM-based detour for non-matched oversize results. Both complement, not replace. Aura is AHEAD on layer-1 (semantic counters + porcelain rewriters) vs openhuman's dumb byte truncation, so the integration point is AFTER TokenJuice rules fail OR result still >threshold. Per-module deep refactor on touch mandatory per CLAUDE.md.

userStories.title: ContextCompressor with SUMMARY_PREFIX + scaled budget + tool-result pre-pruning
userStories.description: New internal/conversation/compressor.go implementing ContextEngine with hermes patterns: (a) SUMMARY_PREFIX filter-safe summarizer preamble (the production-tested handoff prompt — every word is load-bearing per R2). (b) Scaled summary budget: min 2000 tokens, 20% ratio, max 12000 tokens. (c) Tool-result pre-pruning (deterministic 1-liner replacement: `[search_files] content search for 'X' in agent/ -> 12 matches`). (d) JSON-arg sanitization preserving validity (recursively shrink string leaves to ≤200 chars; never produce invalid JSON). (e) Streaming context-tag scrubber that handles `<memory-context>...</memory-context>` split across chunks. (f) Image-aware token budgeting (_IMAGE_TOKEN_ESTIMATE = 1600 per image, matches Claude Code).

userStories.title: payload_summarizer trait with threshold gating + circuit breaker (openhuman pattern)
userStories.description: Trait-based interception of oversized tool results BEFORE they enter agent history. INTEGRATION NOTE: this is layer-2 of the compression stack — sits AFTER internal/tokenjuice (already-live layer-1 rule compactor). Trigger only when TokenJuice rule fails OR rule-compacted output is still >threshold. PayloadSummarizer interface with MaybeSummarize(toolName, parentTaskHint, raw) returning *SummarizedPayload (nil = pass-through). Pass-through guards: (a) below threshold_tokens → skip (no LLM call worth the round-trip), (b) above max_payload_tokens → skip (too expensive, fall through to spill/truncation), (c) circuit breaker tripped (3 consecutive failures in session → disabled for rest of session), (d) summary length >= raw length → reject (summary didn't shrink, pass raw), (e) parent-only scope (summarizer agent itself MUST get nil to prevent recursive dispatch — openhuman observed this in production and now ships with payload_summarizer DISABLED by default). Token estimate `chars/4` (model-agnostic). Summarizer agent prompt: lift from D:/tmp/openhuman/src/openhuman/agent/agents/summarizer/prompt.md as Aura's internal/agent/agents/summarizer/SKILL.md fixture — extraction contract preserves IDs/URLs/paths as required, drops markup noise.

userStories.title: AutoCompactEngine — token-budget compaction at 70% threshold (replace 50-msg cap)
userStories.description: New ContextEngine implementation: AutoCompactEngine. Triggers compaction at 70% of model context window (instead of waiting for 100% / 50-msg cap). Two-scope budget tracking: `Total` (everything in prompt) vs `BodyAfterPrefix` (so overlays + initial-context stay 'free' against cache). Switches Aura's conversation cap semantics from message-count to token-budget. Replace MaxConversationMessages config (currently 50) with MaxConversationTokens (default = 70% of model context window from llm config). Source: Codex core/src/session/turn.rs:301-358, :655-705. Online §3.2 — Anthropic effective context engineering 2026.
